title: Claude Code token limit fixes with four key plugins #shorts #claudecode #token
description: Claude Code’s token limit issues can be permanently resolved using four powerful plugins designed to enhance AI coding workflows. OmniRoot connects Claude Code to over 200 free AI models and automatically switches between them, enabling practically unlimited token usage. Headroom compresses prompts before submission, drastically reducing token consumption for large tasks. ClaudeMem provides long-term memory across sessions, eliminating the need to repeatedly explain your codebase. Claude Code Setup analyzes your codebase and workflow, automatically creating tailored AI skills and recommending optimal MCPs and sub-agents to improve efficiency. Together, these plugins streamline coding with Claude Code by expanding capacity, reducing token waste, and customizing AI assistance. #ClaudeCode #OmniRoot #Headroom #ClaudeMem #AIplugins #AICodingTools #CodeAutomation #MCPs #AIworkflow #TokenLimitSolution #AIsetup #CodebaseAnalysis #LongTermMemory #AIAssistants #CodingEfficiency
